before.descriptionHtml:
Shop porcelain floor and wall tiles in Perth, supplied by Eternity Tiles. Choose from 300x300, 300x600, 600x600 and 600x1200mm sizes in matt, lappato and gloss finishes, across stone-look, cement-look and terrazzo-style ranges.

Porcelain is dense, hard-wearing and suits bathrooms, kitchens, living areas and outdoor spaces. Tiles are sold per square metre to the nearest full box, and our team can help with quantities, grout colour and professional installation.

Visit Excellent Tiling Services at 17A Olga Road, Maddington to see the range in person, or call 0450 960 543. We deliver across Perth metro and can supply and install as part of your bathroom renovation.
